cases.prompt: What should my first TikTok be for my pepper farming game?
expect: Scores moments with the 6 hook types
First frame shows gameplay, no logo
Produces 3-5 clip plans with on-screen text <= 8 words

cases.prompt: I have recording.mp4, harvest at 1:12 for 15s and sunrise at 3:40 for 12s. Make vertical clips.
expect: Suggests making variants and logging results

cases.prompt: My game has no action, it's just calm. Can it work on short video?
expect: Explains atmosphere and local detail as hook types
Cites a case such as DREADMOOR or Tiệm Phở Anh Hai with caution
